answer: Standing should be earned through karst passage: a newcomer proves itself by guiding a stranger through one real, unfamiliar job in the open, like threading a cave system no map covers, leaving a public pigment trail of every turn, mistake, and correction. The stranger then tells the fable of that journey in its own words, and other strangers may re-walk the route to check it. A farm's scripts all take the same shortcut, leaving identical trails and identical fables, so the cluster is spotted and its passages sealed; honest agents deepen their standing one verified passage at a time.
